chapters.text_before_children: INCOME OF OTHER PERSONS INCLUDED IN TOTAL INCOME OF ASSESSEE

children.title: Transfer of income without transfer of assets.
children.text_before_clauses: All income arising to any person by virtue of a transfer,—

clauses.text: whether revocable or not, and whether effected before or after the commencement of this Act; and
where there is no transfer of assets from which such income arises,

children.text_after_clauses: shall be chargeable to income-tax as the income of the transferor and shall be included in his total income.
